synopsis: NHTSA upgraded the Honda case to engineering analysis EA24-002 in April 2024; the skeptic’s review identifies its subject as false automatic braking [f1485, f10422]. The analysis covered 2,997,604 vehicles, specifically 2018–2022 Accord and Accord Hybrid and 2017–2022 CR-V and CR-V Hybrid models [f1485, f10422]. Chapter 2 reports 1,294 complaints of unintended activation and lists EA24-002 alongside PE22-003 and EA25-002 as Honda CMBS on-road car AEB investigations [f1486, f1798]. These facts establish the investigation’s scale and scope, but do not state its outcome or establish applicability to heavy off-road machines [f1485, f10422, f1486, f1798].

relations.note: Both identify the April 2024 analysis and its 2,997,604-vehicle coverage.
Adds 1,294 unintended-activation complaints to the false-braking investigation description.
Places EA24-002 among named Honda CMBS on-road AEB investigations.
